newsitem.title: USA: Royal Dutch/Shell Group Q4 U.S. dlr net up 96 pct.
newsitem.headline: Royal Dutch/Shell Group Q4 U.S. dlr net up 96 pct.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTES: U.S. dollar translation from pound sterling results provided by the Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
Share results based on net split between group's parent companies Royal Dutch Petroleum Co, 60 pct, and Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc, 40 pct. Shell share data is per New York Share equivalent.

The group reported earnings on a FIFO accounting basis. On an estimated CCS -- for current cost of supplies -- basis, which is nearly equal to the LIFO accounting used by most U.S. oil companies, net income was $2,109 million vs $939 million in quarter and $8,274 million vs $6,813 million in year. On a Royal Dutch share basis this was $2.66 vs $1.05 in the quarter and $9.90 vs $8.03 in the year. For Shell it was $1.42 vs $0.62 in quarter and $5.55 vs $4.47 in year.
Q4 group net included charges of $122 million vs $387 million. Year net includes credits $148 million vs charges $324 million.
